Markdown to PDF

Paste or open your Markdown, then tap ••• at the top right and .pdf under export. Rapier writes the PDF in your browser: nothing is uploaded. The text stays searchable, and the Markdown travels inside the PDF, so Rapier can open it again as the same Markdown.

Also: Markdown to Word · Free online Markdown editor and viewer

How to convert Markdown to PDF

  1. Paste your Markdown over the starter text, or tap ••• at the top right, then open, and pick a .md file.
  2. Tap ••• at the top right, then .pdf under export.
  3. Save the PDF. It is written on your device, with searchable text and the Markdown inside it.

Questions

Is it free?

Yes. Rapier is free and open source, with no account, ads or tracking.

Is my file uploaded?

No. Rapier works in your browser. Local editing uploads nothing.

Can I add a page break?

Yes. Tap + on the bar under the text, then Line.

Do tables, code and math come through?

Yes, with pictures, drawings and diagrams, as they look on the page.
